name: Hesperian-Polje
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the north, tectonic rift valleys. Nothing wears any of it smooth.

Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the escape pod debris field are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
